ex.en: He shoved his hands into his pockets and walked silently down the street.
ex.zh: 他把手插进衣袋，默默沿街走去。

words.note: shove 比 push 用力更猛，常带粗鲁意味；shove off 意为走开。

ex.en: The police reported a sharp rise in car theft in the city centre.
ex.zh: 警方报告市中心的汽车盗窃案大幅上升。

words.note: theft 是名词，指偷窃行为；thief 指小偷，注意词性不同。

ex.en: The company refused to disclose the details of the new contract.
ex.zh: 公司拒绝透露这份新合同的细节。

words.note: dis 表相反、close 表关闭，合起来即揭开、揭露；比 reveal 正式。

ex.en: The law guarantees freedom of religion for every citizen in the country.
ex.zh: 法律保障该国每位公民的宗教自由。

words.note: religion 为名词，religious 为形容词；lig 词根表绑缚。

ex.en: They spent the summer sailing a small yacht around the islands.
ex.zh: 他们整个夏天驾着小游艇绕岛航行。

words.note: yacht 的 ch 不发音，读 /jɒt/；注意与 boat 的区别。

ex.en: As mistress of the house, she welcomed every guest at the door.
ex.zh: 作为女主人，她在门口迎接每一位客人。

words.note: mistress 由 master 变来，指女主人；现代也常指情妇。

ex.en: The red colour of the soil comes from iron oxide in the rock.
ex.zh: 土壤的红色来自岩石中的氧化铁。

words.note: oxi 与氧（oxygen）有关；-ide 表示化合物，如 oxide。

ex.en: The model village shows the whole city in miniature.
ex.zh: 这个模型村以缩影形式展现了整座城市。

words.note: in miniature 是固定短语，意为按比例缩小地、缩影。

ex.en: The whole clan gathered at the old house every spring festival.
ex.zh: 每逢春节，整个宗族都会聚在那座老宅里。

words.note: clan 指有共同祖先的宗族，比 family 范围大。

ex.en: This small car is economical to run and easy to park in the city.
ex.zh: 这辆小车使用成本低，在城里也容易停放。

words.note: economical 指节约的，economic 指经济的，勿混用。

ex.en: The port grew into a prosperous trading city within a single generation.
ex.zh: 这个港口在一代人的时间里发展成繁荣的贸易城市。

words.note: prosper 加 ous 即繁荣的；名词 prosperity 也是高频词。

ex.en: He polished his speech for two days before the final presentation.
ex.zh: 决赛演讲前，他把讲稿润色了两天。

words.note: polish 既指擦亮，也指润色文章、改进技艺。

ex.en: After the losses, the board reassessed its plan for overseas expansion.
ex.zh: 在遭受亏损后，董事会重新评估了海外扩张计划。

words.note: re 表再、assess 表评估，即重新评估；名词 reassessment。

ex.en: The prime minister called a cabinet meeting to discuss the budget.
ex.zh: 首相召开内阁会议讨论预算问题。

words.note: cabinet 既指橱柜，也指内阁，看上下文判断。

ex.en: The desert heat often creates an optical illusion of water on the road.
ex.zh: 沙漠高温常在路上造成有水的视觉错觉。

words.note: optic 与眼睛有关，optical 多指视觉的、光学的。

ex.en: The old song evoked memories of the summer we spent by the sea.
ex.zh: 那首老歌唤起了我们在海边度夏的回忆。

words.note: e 表出、voke 表喊，即唤出；多接 memory、feeling。

ex.en: You should take out travel insurance before you go abroad.
ex.zh: 出国之前你应该购买旅行保险。

words.note: insurance 不可数；take out insurance 意为购买保险。

ex.en: The headlights of the truck dazzled him and he slowed down at once.
ex.zh: 卡车的前灯晃得他眼花，他立刻减速。

words.note: dazzle 指强光使人目眩，也可喻指使人倾倒。

ex.en: He refused the offer on principle, though it would have made him rich.
ex.zh: 尽管那笔交易会让他发财，他还是出于原则拒绝了。

words.note: principle 是原则，principal 是主要的、校长，切勿混。

ex.en: The player pulled a muscle in his thigh during the second half.
ex.zh: 这名球员在下半场拉伤了大腿肌肉。

words.note: thigh 中 gh 不发音，读 /θaɪ/；注意与 thing 区别。

ex.en: Copying the same figures all day is tedious but it must be done.
ex.zh: 整天抄同样的数字很枯燥，但这项工作必须完成。

words.note: tedious 强调冗长而令人厌倦，比 boring 更书面。

ex.en: She tilted her head slightly and listened to the strange sound again.
ex.zh: 她微微歪着头，又听了听那奇怪的声音。

words.note: tilt 指轻微倾斜；at full tilt 意为全速地。

ex.en: Constant comparison with others can give children a lasting sense of inferiority.
ex.zh: 总与他人比较会让孩子产生长期的自卑感。

words.note: inferiority 来自 inferior（较差的），反义 superiority。

ex.en: Each participant in the study was asked to keep a daily diary.
ex.zh: 这项研究的每位参与者都被要求每天写日记。

words.note: participant 后接 in；动词 participate 也接 in。

ex.en: The city initiated a project to clean up the polluted river last year.
ex.zh: 该市去年启动了一个治理污染河流的项目。

words.note: initiate 重音在第二音节；名词 initiative 指主动性、倡议。

ex.en: Domestic flights are usually cheaper than international ones in this country.
ex.zh: 在这个国家，国内航班通常比国际航班便宜。

words.note: domestic 兼指国内的与家庭的，如 domestic market。

ex.en: The driver glared at the cyclist who had cut in front of him.
ex.zh: 司机怒视着那个突然插到他前面的骑车人。

words.note: glare at 是怒目而视；作名词指刺眼的强光。

ex.en: Farmers here depend on an irrigation system built over fifty years ago.
ex.zh: 这里的农民依靠五十多年前修建的灌溉系统。

words.note: irrigation 来自 irrigate（灌溉），也可指冲洗伤口。

ex.en: The team compiled a list of every species found on the island.
ex.zh: 该团队编制了一份岛上所有物种的清单。

words.note: compile 指收集资料汇编成册；名词 compilation。

ex.en: The old market district is full of vitality again after the renovation.
ex.zh: 翻修之后，老市场区又充满了活力。

words.note: vital（有活力的）加 ity；同根词 vital、vitalize。
